Name: More Books
Author: Vladislavjzk
Description:
[size=5][b][center]Adds 16 new books and powers.[/center][/b][/size]
[size=5][b]Installation & Usage[/b][/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3]Download the zipped file, and unzip its full contents into your Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Books[/size][/b]
[size=3]Currently, this mod adds 16 books. Please see the spoiler section below to know what they do.

[spoiler][b][size=3]Carpenter Catalogue[/size][/b]
Effect: You can now purchase hardwood and clay from Robin, also you get a 10% discount at her shop.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Robin will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with her. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Ore Catalogue[/size][/b]
Effect: You can now purchase iridium ore from Clint, also you get a 10% discount at his shop.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Clint will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Immunity Boost[/size][/b]
Effect: Gain +1 Immunity (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Sold from bookseller for 20000g, requires combat level 3. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Fisherman's Guide[/size][/b]
Effect: Gain +1 Fishing level (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Sold by Willy for 20000g, requires 6 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Fortune Guide[/size][/b]
Effect: Gain +1 Luck (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Traded from bookseller for 50000g and lucky ring. It becomes available in year 2 once Joja Mart or the Community Center is completed. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Haste Guide[/size][/b]
Effect: Gain +0.5 Speed (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Traded from bookseller for 50000g and 20 green tea. It becomes available in year 2 once Joja Mart or the Community Center is completed. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Magnetic Mastery Manual[/size][/b]
Effect: Increase magnetism by 2 tiles (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Sold from bookseller for 30000g, requires mining level 4. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Lucky Shorts Mystery[/size][/b]
Effect: Now you can sell lucky shorts for 1000g.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Lewis will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Rice Cultivation Excellence[/size][/b]
Effect: Unmilled rice is now priced at 100g, while milled rice costs 200g.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Pierre will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]Dagger Mastery Guide[/size][/b]
Effect: Daggers deal 1.5x damage.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Sold by Marlon for 10000g, requires 1 heart with Dwarf. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]The Art of Tea Cultivation[/size][/b]
Effect: Tea leaves and Green Tea costs 2x more.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Caroline will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with her. [/spoiler]

[b][size=3]The Alleyway Buffet pt.2[/size][/b]
Effect: Now there is a 7% chance of finding gems (Emerald, Aquamarine, Ruby, Amethyst, Topaz, Jade or Diamond) in the garbage can.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Linus will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b]Combat Codex[/b]
Effect: Gain +2 Attack (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Sold from bookseller for 25000g, requires combat level 4. [/spoiler]

[b]Dairy Mastery[/b]
Effect: Milk and Cheese costs more (approximately 20%).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Marnie will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with her. [/spoiler]

[b]Blast Manual[/b]
Effect: Bomb prices are back to pre-1.6, and crafting bombs is now easier.
How to obtain: [spoiler] Dwarf will send you a gift by mail once you reach 10 hearts with him. [/spoiler]

[b]Divine Insight[/b]
Effect: Gain +5 Speed, +10 Luck, +10 Immunity, +10 Fishing Levels, +100 Defense, +8 Magnetic Tiles, x5 Damage (configurable).
How to obtain: [spoiler] Available for purchase at the Qi Gem Shop for 2000 Qi Gems after accessing The Summit. [/spoiler]
[/spoiler][/size]

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size]
[/b][size=3]Configurations can be accessed using the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod. Changes made to the configuration will take effect in the game starting from the next in-game day (for optimization purposes).[/size]

[size=5][b]Recommended[/b]
[/size][size=3]If you have other mods that introduce new Special Items & Powers, you can utilize the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22300][size=3]Special Power Utilities[/size][/url] mod to help you easily navigate your Powers tab.[/size]
